[LLM] Locale-conditional rm -rf wiper command from python/node runtime Actions on Objectives High
Detects the durabletask wiper logic — a one-in-six destructive rm -rf /* invoked from a Python/Node interpreter on hosts with Israeli or Iranian locale. The rm -rf /* + python/node parent combination is the article's exact tradecraft. Rationale: The article states: 'On hosts with Israeli or Iranian locale settings, a one-in-six roll ran rm -rf /*'. The parent==python/node + cmdline==`rm -rf /*` combination is the literal article-specific impact behavior — extremely high signal because a developer never legitimately wipes their own root.
ATT&CKT1485 T1561.001
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("python.exe","python3.exe","node.exe","python","python3","node")
| where FileName in~ ("rm","sh","bash","busybox","dash")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brm\s+-rf\s+(/\*?|--no-preserve-root)"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("python","python3","node","python.exe","python3.exe","node.exe")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brm\s+-rf\s+(/\*?|--no-preserve-root)"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
title: rm -rf Wiper Spawned from Python/Node Runtime
id: 2a8d6e7f-93c1-4b50-8e2f-c47a9d1b35e0
status: experimental
description: Detects the durabletask backdoor wiper logic — a destructive rm -rf /* spawned from a Python or Node interpreter (one-in-six probability on hosts with Israeli/Iranian locale per the article).
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/edr-proxy-wont-protect-supply-chain-malware
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/03
tags:
  - attack.t1485
  - attack.t1561.001
  - attack.impact
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/node'
  cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'rm -rf /*'
      - 'rm -rf /'
      - 'rm -rf --no-preserve-root'
  condition: parent and cmdline
level: critical
(source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.command_line:("rm -rf /*" OR "rm -rf /" OR "rm -rf --no-preserve-root")) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @CommandLine:(*"rm -rf /*"* OR *"rm -rf /"* OR *"--no-preserve-root"*) @ParentImage:(*\python.exe OR *\python3.exe OR *\node.exe OR *\PYTHON.EXE OR *\NODE.EXE))
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(python3?|node)(\.exe)?$/i ImageFileName=/^(rm|sh|bash|busybox|dash)$/i
| regex("\\brm\\s+-rf\\s+(/|--no-preserve-root)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ENDPOINT
Toggle if your env has no CIM data-model acceleration.
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python","python3","node","python.exe","python3.exe","node.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rm","sh","bash","busybox","dash") AND (Processes.process="*rm -rf /*" OR Processes.process="*rm -rf /" OR Processes.process="*rm -rf --no-preserve-root*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python","python3","node","python.exe","python3.exe","node.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rm","sh","bash","busybox","dash") AND (Processes.process="*rm -rf /*" OR Processes.process="*rm -rf /" OR Processes.process="*rm -rf --no-preserve-root*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
Trusted vendor binary / installer launching unusual children Exploitation Medium
Supply-chain trojan signal: legitimate signed binary spawning script interpreters or exotic LOLBins.
ATT&CKT1195.002
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes DeviceProcessEvents
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("setup.exe","installer.exe","update.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
// Replace `"setup.exe","installer.exe","update.exe"` with the vendor binaries observed in the
// article (matching shape with the Defender query).
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("setup.exe","installer.exe","update.exe")
| where NewProcessName endswith "\powershell.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\cmd.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\rundll32.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\regsvr32.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\mshta.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\wscript.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\cscript.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\wmic.exe"
   or NewProcessName endswith "\bitsadmin.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Trusted Vendor Binary Launching Unusual Children
id: 7c8b2e10-4d4f-4a8c-9c1f-bf6e2c4a8d09
status: experimental
description: |
    A signed vendor binary (in the article's named-vendors list)
    spawning script-host or LOLBin children. Strongest signal when
    paired with a recent CVE / supply-chain advisory naming the same
    vendor.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1195/
author: Clankerusecase
date: 2026/05/02
tags:
    - attack.t1195
    - attack.initial-access
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\rundll32.exe'
            - '\regsvr32.exe'
            - '\mshta.exe'
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'
            - '\wmic.exe'
            - '\bitsadmin.exe'
    selection_parent_vendor:
        ParentImage|contains:
            - '\Program Files\'
            - '\Program Files (x86)\'
    condition: selection_child and selection_parent_vendor
falsepositives:
    - Many — installers and updaters legitimately spawn children. Pin
      the parent path to specific vendor binaries observed in the
      article before alerting.
level: medium

        | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,

// Pre-filter both ASIM tables before the union — same pattern as the
// Defender version so the engine can push hash predicates per-side.
let BadHashes = dynamic(["069ac1dc7f7649b76bc72a11ac700f373804bfd81dab7e561157b703999f44ce", "7d80b3ef74ad7992b93c31966962612e4e2ceb93e7727cdbd1d2a9af47d44ba8", "3de04fe2a76262743ed089efa7115f4508619838e77d60b9a1aab8b20d2cc8bf", "aeaf583e20347bf850e2fabdcd6f4982996ba023f8c2cd56bbd299cfd56516f5", "85f54c089d78ebfb101454ec934c767065a342a43c9ee1beac8430cdd3b2086f", "877ff2531a63393c4cb9a3c86908b62d9c4fc3db971bc231c48537faae6cb3ec", "c0b094e46842260936d4b97ce63e4539b99a3eae48b736798c700217c52569dc", "2553649f2322049666871cea80a5d0d6adc700ca", "d6f3f62fd3b9f5432f5782b62d8cfd5247d5ee71", "07d889e2dadce6f3910dcbc253317d28ca61c766"]);
union
    ( ImFileEvent
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
        | where TargetFileSHA256 in~ (BadHashes)
           or TargetFileSHA1 in~ (BadHashes)
           or TargetFileMD5 in~ (BadHashes)
        | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType,
                  TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256,
                  Cmd = ActingProcessName, Source = "ImFileEvent" ),
    ( ImProcessCreate
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
        | where SHA256 in~ (BadHashes) or SHA1 in~ (BadHashes) or MD5 in~ (BadHashes)
        | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType = TargetProcessName,
                  TargetFileName = TargetProcessName, TargetFilePath = TargetProcessName,
                  TargetFileSHA256 = SHA256,
                  Cmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, Source = "ImProcessCreate" )
| order by TimeGenerated desc

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Why EDR and proxy won’t save you from supply chain malware
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
